findings.learnerImpact: The slider read 'Gain level 8' while the caption read 'Gain 100 - Contrast 43'; the contrast figure described a clip that does not vary contrast.

findings.investigation: The last-touched-control requirement is real, not stale state: the lookup holds one clip per step of one control, so the clip on screen is a gain example only while gain is the control last moved, and the goal is to hold a gain example.
findings.change: labGoalRequirements reports the same conditions labGoalMet applies; a test holds the two to the same answer for every lab in the course. The criterion itself is unchanged.

findings.rootCause: Changing a control cleared the ready key, which disabled the whole fieldset for about 20 ms (sampled at 8 ms: enabled -> disabled at 51 ms -> enabled at 73 ms), and a disabled control loses focus. Focus went to BODY on the first change, so every later arrow press went nowhere.
findings.change: Selection controls always apply the latest intent; the fieldset stays enabled and aria-busy while a clip decodes; readiness still waits for the decode and no stale provenance is reported while it does.
findings.evidence: Four rapid steps applied, focus on 'Image gain' throughout.

findings.rootCause: allowed('freeze') requires freeze in config.controls, and no guided simulator lab has it, so it rendered permanently disabled in all of them.
findings.change: Absent in a guided lab that was not given it. Not enabled: nothing bypasses the bridge and no stale pixels are labelled current.

findings.evidence: The section's viewBox is the phantom coordinate system itself, so a 10 mm bar, decade depth ticks and a midline mark are exact. Fields read 'phantom mm, 0 at the midline' and 'phantom mm from the top of the field'.

phantomPlaneReference derives the section, axes, lengths and ideal caliper line from the exact current plane: central elongated plane short 16.0 / long 32.0 mm; at offset 6 the short axis is 16*sqrt(1-0.36) = 12.8 mm. Openable at any time, including before an attempt.
